events.event_description: Joins Saturday Night Live cast
events.evidence_text: Downey joined the Saturday Night Live cast in 1985.

events.event_description: Divorce from Deborah Falconer finalized
events.evidence_text: Divorce from Falconer was finalized in 2004.

events.event_description: Marries producer Susan Levin
events.evidence_text: Married Susan Levin on August 27, 2005.

events.evidence_text: Downey revitalized his career starring as Iron Man, beginning with Iron Man (2008).

events.evidence_text: Sherlock Holmes won Downey the Golden Globe for Best Actor – Musical or Comedy.

events.event_description: Named Forbes highest-paid actor (2013–2015)
events.evidence_text: Forbes named him highest-paid actor in 2013, 2014 and 2015, earning $75–80 million.

events.event_description: Pardoned by California Governor Jerry Brown for past drug convictions
events.evidence_text: In December 2015 he was one of 91 people pardoned by Governor Jerry Brown.

events.event_description: Academy Award Best Supporting Actor for Oppenheimer (first Oscar)
events.evidence_text: Downey won his first Oscar, Best Supporting Actor, for playing Lewis Strauss in Oppenheimer.

events.evidence_text: Joined The All-New Mickey Mouse Club in December 1992.

events.event_description: Debut album ...Baby One More Time released
events.evidence_text: Debut single released 1998 and debut album January 1999 launched her career.

events.event_description: Legally marries Kevin Federline
events.evidence_text: Wedding ceremony September 18, legal marriage to Federline October 6, 2004.

events.event_description: First Grammy: Best Dance Recording for "Toxic"
events.evidence_text: "Toxic" won Spears her first Grammy for Best Dance Recording.

events.event_description: First son Sean Preston born
events.evidence_text: First son born September 2005.

events.event_description: Files for divorce from Federline (finalized July 2007)
events.evidence_text: Spears filed for divorce from Federline, citing irreconcilable differences; finalized July 2007.

events.event_description: Rehab stay and public head-shaving breakdown
events.evidence_text: She shaved her head with electric clippers at a Tarzana salon in February 2007.

events.event_description: "Gimme More" MTV VMA performance widely panned
events.evidence_text: Her September 2007 VMA "Gimme More" performance was widely panned.

events.event_description: Psychiatric hold followed by court-ordered temporary conservatorship under her father
events.evidence_text: Father named temporary conservator a day after she was taken to a psychiatric hospital.

events.event_description: Album Circus released after conservatorship made indefinite
events.evidence_text: Circus released December 2008, two months after conservatorship was extended indefinitely.

events.event_description: Las Vegas residency Britney: Piece of Me begins (later extended)
events.evidence_text: Piece of Me residency began December 27, 2013; extended two years in 2014.

events.event_description: Announces indefinite work hiatus, cancels Domination residency
events.evidence_text: Spears announced an indefinite work hiatus, putting her Las Vegas residency on hold.

events.event_description: Judge terminates 13-year conservatorship
events.evidence_text: Judge Brenda Penny ruled the conservatorship of Britney Jean Spears is no longer required.

events.event_description: Divorce from Sam Asghari
events.evidence_text: Marriage to Asghari ended in divorce in 2024.

events.event_description: National TV debut on The Merv Griffin Show
events.evidence_text: Introduced nationally in June 1983 performing "Home" on The Merv Griffin Show.

events.event_description: Debut album Whitney Houston released (best-selling album of 1986)
events.evidence_text: Her debut album was released February 14, 1985 and was the best-selling album the next year.

events.event_description: First Grammy: Best Female Pop Vocal for "Saving All My Love for You"
events.evidence_text: First Grammy in 1986 for "Saving All My Love for You".

events.event_description: Marries Bobby Brown
events.evidence_text: After a three-year courtship, the two were married on July 18, 1992.

events.event_description: The Bodyguard film and soundtrack (best-selling soundtrack of all time)
events.evidence_text: The Bodyguard remains the best-selling soundtrack of all time, over 45 million units.

events.event_description: Daughter Bobbi Kristina Brown born

events.event_description: Grammy Album of the Year and Record of the Year (The Bodyguard)
events.evidence_text: Houston won 1994 Album of the Year for The Bodyguard soundtrack.

events.evidence_text: Airport security discovered half an ounce of marijuana in her handbag on January 11, 2000.

events.evidence_text: Houston was fired from her Academy Awards performance by musical director Burt Bacharach.

events.event_description: Arista contract renewed for $100 million

events.evidence_text: Drug use and a tumultuous marriage tarnished her image, overshadowing Just Whitney (2002).

events.evidence_text: The divorce was granted on April 24, 2007.

events.event_description: Comeback album I Look to You
events.evidence_text: Released I Look to You in 2009.

events.event_description: Re-enters rehabilitation for drug and alcohol problems
events.evidence_text: In May 2011 Houston enrolled in rehabilitation again for drug and alcohol problems.

events.event_description: Accidental drowning at Beverly Hilton; heart disease and cocaine contributing
events.evidence_text: Coroner ruled accidental drowning, with heart disease and cocaine use contributing.

events.event_description: Sun Records session produces "That's All Right"
events.evidence_text: The July 5, 1954 Sun session produced "That's All Right".

events.event_description: Contract bought by RCA Victor for $40,000
events.evidence_text: RCA Victor bought his contract on November 21, 1955 for $40,000.

events.event_description: "Heartbreak Hotel" released; national breakthrough

events.event_description: First Ed Sullivan Show appearance
events.evidence_text: First Ed Sullivan Show appearance on September 9, 1956.

events.event_description: Drafted into US Army; career paused until 1960

events.event_description: Honorably discharged; returns to music and films
events.evidence_text: Returned to the US March 2, 1960 and was honorably discharged three days later.

events.event_description: Marries Priscilla Beaulieu in Las Vegas
events.evidence_text: They married on May 1, 1967 at the Aladdin Hotel in Las Vegas.

events.event_description: Daughter Lisa Marie born
events.evidence_text: Only child Lisa Marie born February 1, 1968, while unhappy with his career.

events.event_description: NBC '68 Comeback Special airs, reviving career
events.evidence_text: The NBC special aired December 3, 1968 and revitalized his career.

events.event_description: Aloha from Hawaii broadcast live via satellite
events.evidence_text: Aloha from Hawaii aired live via satellite on January 14, 1973.

events.event_description: Divorce from Priscilla finalized
events.evidence_text: Presley's divorce settlement was finalized on October 9, 1973.

events.event_description: Hospitalized from effects of pethidine addiction (late 1973)
events.evidence_text: In late 1973 he was hospitalized from the effects of a pethidine addiction.

events.event_description: Dies at Graceland, aged 42
events.evidence_text: Found unconscious at Graceland and pronounced dead August 16, 1977.

events.event_description: Marries James Dougherty at 16
events.evidence_text: Married James Dougherty on June 19, 1942.

events.evidence_text: Divorced Dougherty in September 1946.

events.evidence_text: Married Joe DiMaggio on January 14, 1954 in San Francisco.

events.event_description: Files for divorce from DiMaggio (final 1955)
events.evidence_text: Filed for divorce from DiMaggio in October 1954.

events.event_description: Marries Arthur Miller
events.evidence_text: Married Arthur Miller June 29, 1956 in White Plains, New York.

events.event_description: Ectopic pregnancy (mid-1957), miscarriage a year later
events.evidence_text: She had an ectopic pregnancy in mid-1957 and a miscarriage a year later.

events.event_description: Golden Globe Best Actress (Comedy) for Some Like It Hot
events.evidence_text: She won a Golden Globe for Some Like It Hot, a critical and commercial success.

events.event_description: Mexican divorce from Arthur Miller
events.evidence_text: She obtained a Mexican divorce from Miller in January 1961.

events.event_description: The Misfits released and fails at box office
events.evidence_text: The Misfits was released the following month, failing at the box office.

events.event_description: Admitted to Payne Whitney Psychiatric Clinic
events.evidence_text: She admitted herself to the Payne Whitney Psychiatric Clinic and was placed in a locked ward.

events.event_description: Fired from Something's Got to Give and sued for $750,000
events.evidence_text: On June 7, Fox fired Monroe and sued her for $750,000.

events.event_description: Dies of barbiturate overdose at home, aged 36
events.evidence_text: On August 4, 1962, Monroe died at age 36 of a barbiturate overdose.

events.event_description: Debut album Madonna (Sire Records)
events.evidence_text: She rose to fame with her debut album, Madonna (1983).

events.evidence_text: Like a Virgin released November 12, 1984, her first number-one album in the US.

events.evidence_text: Pepsi withdrew the commercial and terminated her sponsorship after religious groups protested.

events.evidence_text: Her 1993 films Body of Evidence and Dangerous Game were poorly received.

events.event_description: Daughter Lourdes born
events.evidence_text: Gave birth to daughter Lourdes on October 14, 1996.

events.event_description: Golden Globe Best Actress for Evita
